name: Notification levels: Chats, Badge, Morning report or Off
author: miguel
description: Each source goes to one place, loudest to quietest: Chats, Badge, a line in the Morning report, or Off. Adds a System group (app updates, app connections, Wizard updates) with a Recent list; System notices on Badge count on the Settings cog. Choices are saved on the box, the same on every device.
